title: An 850 mm stainless-steel annealing and pickling line: supply scope for the annealing and solution-treatment section
summary: Suneng supplied equipment for the annealing furnace and solution-treatment cooling section of a customer's continuous stainless steel strip annealing and pickling line. Compare similar strip projects by first matching actual width, thickness and temperature progression, then reviewing heating, cooling, drying and whole-line interfaces separately. Drawing on the project technical annex and project records, this page explains that assessment. Proposal parameters are not actual output or acceptance results.
